data.name: Muddassir
data.gender_notes: Muddassir is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'd-r-r', meaning to observe or to see. The name Muddassir is used to describe one who is an observer or a watcher. In Islamic tradition, it is believed that those who are constantly in the presence of Allah (SWT) are the true observers, as they are always aware of His divine presence and guidance.
data.spiritual_meaning: One who illuminates the path for others
data.etymology: Muddassir belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Observer, Watcher.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Muddassir total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: مُدassis
in_arabic.meaning: المُدassis هو الاسم الذي يعني الحصار أو الربط بالرخص
